notes.title: Ending 04
notes.notes:
Have you ever wondered why Benjamin Cooper could acquire knowledge that clearly exceeded his own capabilities? Why was there a Benjamin Cooper in the state of a beeper in the church in the forest in 1991? And who exactly formulated the plan to kill the monster?
Friends who have completed the game know that there are actually two crystals in the time box obtained in Video 01. But friends, have you ever thought about opening the time box right then?
Yes, Ending 04 is a branch plot that starts from that moment, and it can explain the plot beyond the main story.
This ending is the final branch plot of "BoppFiles".

notes.notes: Two new maps have been added: choosing not to shoot in the showdown can lead to the end of the world ending, and failing the final QTE can lead to another route.

notes.title: Addition of the end of the world ending.

notes.title: I have added some playable elements in the bug*3
notes.notes:
As it is well known, the pager in the second level misleads the player with a bunch of passwords in an extremely verbose fashion, which is intended to reflect the differences in character between the pager and the devil. However, some people may treat those randomly-cited passwords as the real ones. Hence, I've decided to:

No modifications at all!

Well, to be serious, I've in fact slightly modified the logic of this section. Due to the fact that the passwords obtained by the players are persistent, getting the passwords beforehand may lead to a mismatch between the monster's dialogue and the player's status. Therefore, I've altered the logic of this part to accept password inputs only after you've acquired the pager.

You should have noticed the QR code floating in the air. That's a part of a bigger in-game mystery, functioning as an introductory gateway. That QR code hints to players to enter the game at midnight. I won't spill more beans.

As for the plot progression, ending 2 doesn't really resolve the problem with the monster. After all, if as a player, you’re wandering around an equipped device blatantly, how could the monster possibly miss it?
